doc.title: Exception Class
doc.para:
Exception Class The Exception class is a class for generating exception objects. The constructor syntax is as follows:
new Exception(<message>)
The message is set to the message property of the created object. In addition, the trace property records information such as functions passed through up to the point where the exception occurred (recorded as a human-readable string). All exception objects caused by factors other than scripts are Exception class objects (for example, division by zero exceptions, etc.).
More available properties may be added in the future.
message The message property is a property that represents a string indicating the reason for the exception.
